title: Plain Text - Dylan Beattie - NDC Copenhagen 2022
summary: Dylan Beattie's conference talk explores the history and mess behind plain text: encodings, Unicode, line endings and the many ways text goes wrong. It argues that the tidy idea of plain text hides a lot of complexity underneath everyday software.
why: HN people recommend it as an entertaining, surprisingly deep talk that comes up whenever encodings, mojibake or Unicode are discussed.

quote.text: you owe it to yourself to check out this super entertaining talk
